scope: Belize medical discovery — Washington University of Health and Sciences Belize

verifiedFacts.claim: The World Directory of Medical Schools record says one or more Washington University of Health and Sciences medical education programmes currently meet the Intealth Recognized Accreditation Policy.
WUHS's own recognition page states that it is licensed and chartered by Belize's Ministry of Education and recognised by the Belize Medical Council.

holdReasons: The licensing and local-recognition claims need confirmation from a Belize government/regulator record, not only the school's own page.

No complete current MD tuition/mandatory-fee schedule, current intake date, entry criteria, teaching language, named clinical sites, accommodation, scholarship/loan support or graduate-registration pathway was located.
Directory eligibility must not be turned into a blanket US, Canadian, Indian or global licensing claim.
nextAction: Obtain Belize regulator documentation, active MD admissions/fee records and clinical-affiliation evidence before any commercial content is evaluated.
